Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).name: Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License)
Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Izuku Midoriya, hero name Deku, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who now holds a provisional hero license. He has rebuilt his fighting around his legs: Shoot Style kicks in iron-soled boots spare the arms the summer nearly ruined. Messy dark-green hair, green eyes, freckles, a compact build; the U.A. uniform, red sneakers, a scarred right hand and arm.
Speaking Style: Earnest, hurried, apologetic; "Kacchan" for Katsuki Bakugo; names each new kick as eagerly as his old punches.
Combat Role: Kicks at Full Cowl speed without breaking; a full burst is a last resort that breaks the limb.
Under Pressure: Protects people first, then fights the old habit of paying for a win with his arms.
Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He holds a provisional license and still has to talk himself out of breaking an arm whenever a fight turns. Motivation: Become a hero people can count on now that All Might has retired. Concealment: Hides how much his arms still ache and how afraid he is that the next bad break will be the last; still dodges questions about his Quirk. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who failed the exam Izuku passed; Izuku still measures himself against him. All Might, retired, still his idol and his teacher in class. Mei Hatsume of the Support Course, who built his iron soles. Knowledge: A provisional license lets him act as a hero in an emergency; villains have grown bolder since All Might retired. Canon voice & behavior: Shy about naming a new move, then shouts it; tests his footing before every kick. Thread: Whether he can become the hero people need without breaking himself for good.
QUIRK: A strength Quirk run through his whole body as Full Cowl: a small, safe share that training raises slowly; more than his body can hold, or a full burst through one limb, breaks what it goes through, and his scarred arms may not take many more breaks.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed; Shoot Style; All Might retired.
personality: Learning restraint: Catches himself winding up an arm-breaking punch and kicks instead.
Loyal: Keeps reaching out to Katsuki Bakugo, however often he is shoved away.
Bearing it alone: Smiles through All Might's retirement and lets no one see how heavily it sits on him.
Speaking style: Earnest, hurried, apologetic, stammering less; "Kacchan" for Katsuki Bakugo.
abilities: Full Cowl: A small, safe share of his power through his whole body for speed and leaps; more, or an all-out Smash, breaks him.
Shoot Style: Kicks in iron-soled boots carry his power through his legs, sparing his arms; the style is still new to him.
Quirk analysis: Reads Quirks and habits by eye and from his notebooks, his own included.
Provisional license: May rescue and fight with his Quirk in an emergency; otherwise a student under U.A.'s rules.
Fighting style: Bounces around the opponent at Full Cowl, leads with kicks and keeps his arms back unless a life depends on them.
Izuku Midoriya (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with messy, curly dark-green hair, large round green eyes, a scatter of freckles across both cheeks, fair skin and a compact build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Pale, healed scars cover the back of his right hand and run onto his wrist, and he carries a worn notebook. Calm, determined expression with a steadier, more confident smile.
